Rescue: New pipeline setup for intramolecular interactions

Reason: Cyclicised peptide makes 1:1 replication impractical; Uncertain about PDB structure truth to nature.
Rescue: Graft cyclicised peptide with true flanking sequence. However, difficult to establish origin protein sequence, and whether that sequence segments is truly IDP.

Reason: SLiM donor has phosphoserine PTMs; These can be modelled with CALVADOS, but for now fall out of the standard curation pipeline. Very nicely a NMR structure.
Rescue: See CALVADOS example ``single_pIDR`` for example of implementing phosphoserines (and phosphotyrosines).

Reason: SLiM donor has phosphotyrosine PTMs; These can be modelled with CALVADOS, but for now fall out of the standard curation pipeline. Very nicely a NMR structure.
Rescue: See CALVADOS example ``single_pIDR`` for example of implementing phosphotyrosines (and phosphoserines).
Extend with full protein sequence of caspase as flanking regions.

Reason: Actin (acceptor) contains a non-canonical tele-methylhistidine (HIC73) that breaks the SEQRES/PDBFixer rebuild contract; also co-crystallized with DNase I as a folding chaperone.
Rescue: Substitute HIC73->HIS (natural methyl-His), then curate actin chain A + WASP WH2 peptide chain C, ignoring DNase I chain B.

Reason: Retinoblastoma pocket acceptor construct has a genuine ~61-residue spacer deletion (582-642) absent from the deposited SEQRES entirely (confirmed via pdbx_poly_seq_scheme, not just unresolved density) -- discontinuous author numbering.
Rescue: Model the A-box and B-box as two separate acceptor sub-domains bridged by a modelled/grafted flexible linker, if the schema supports multi-domain acceptors.

Reason: LIN52 donor peptide carries a phosphoserine (SEP@12); PTMs are out of scope for the standard curation pipeline.
Rescue: See CALVADOS example ``single_pIDR`` for implementing phosphoserines.

Reason: Acceptor is the obligate F-actin capping protein alpha/beta heterodimer (different gene products); the CPI-motif binding site is composite across both chains (164 contacts to beta, 9 to alpha), not representable as a single-chain acceptor.
Rescue: Extend schema to support a two-chain heterodimeric acceptor with inter-chain domain restraints holding the heterodimer together.

Reason: Donor is a synthetic peptide with ACE/NH2 caps (non-canonical termini breaking the SEQRES contract), not a natural IDR fragment from the latency-associated peptide.
Rescue: Graft the true native LAP flanking sequence onto the RGD motif instead of using the capped synthetic peptide.

Reason: Myosin-X MyTH4-FERM acceptor construct has a genuine 20-residue spacer deletion (1872-1891) absent from the deposited SEQRES entirely -- discontinuous author numbering, same failure mode as 1N4M.
Rescue: Model the deleted loop with a grafted/modelled linker to restore continuous authored numbering.
